name: Kai'Sa
notes: Living Weapon evolutions are assumed active on all three basic abilities for the whole fight (a six-item level-16 build plausibly meets every stat threshold): Icathian Rain fires 12 missiles, Void Seeker applies 3 Plasma stacks and refunds 75% of its remaining cooldown on hitting the (champion-type) dummy, and Supercharge's evolution (brief invisibility) has no damage effect and is ignored.

Icathian Rain has no cast time per the wiki (the numbers sheet's 0.25s is not used); all of its missiles are modeled landing together as one damage instance 0.4s after cast rather than spreading across the up-to-1s convergence window.
Void Seeker has a 0.4s cast time; its Plasma applications, its own bolt damage, and any Caustic Wounds detonation it triggers all resolve together when the cast ends, then its cooldown is refunded.

Supercharge's cast time uses the wiki's dynamic formula 1.2s/(1+bonus AS/100), floor 0.6s, recomputed from current bonus attack speed at each cast, instead of the numbers sheet's flat 1.5s field (the two conflict and only the wiki gives the by-AS breakdown). Attack commands are fully converted to movement for the whole charge, not just the standard 0.25s cast lockout, and Supercharge is cast on cooldown throughout the fight.

Each basic attack applies 1 Plasma stack (Caustic Wounds magic damage); Void Seeker applies 3 stacks successively, each dealing its own Caustic Wounds instance. The 5th stack detonates all stacks for bonus missing-health magic damage, computed after the triggering Caustic Wounds damage (and after Void Seeker's own bolt damage when Void Seeker is the trigger); the 400 monster cap does not apply since the dummy counts as an enemy champion. Plasma decays after 4s without reapplication.
Killer Instinct (R) deals no damage and its only combat effect (an attack-timer reset) is worthless before any attack has been queued, so it is never cast.
Mana costs are not modeled: nothing here plausibly runs out of mana inside a short fight.

Supercharge's extra windup reduction and increased missile speed during its post-charge buff are not modeled (the underlying formula is unresolved in the sheet); only its attack-speed percentage buff is applied.

assumed.why: assumes Icathian Rain is evolved (12 missiles) from item AD thresholds met by the build
assumes Void Seeker is evolved (3 Plasma stacks, 75% cooldown refund on champion hit) from item AP thresholds met by the build
chooses the wiki's dynamic cast-time formula over the numbers sheet's flat 1.5s, which conflicts with the by-AS tooltip values
chooses the wiki's Void Seeker cooldown array (20 to 14) over the numbers sheet ddragon field (22 to 14), which the dossier flags as conflicting
simplifies Icathian Rain's up-to-1s missile convergence into one instant landing 0.4s after cast
